subject: test: move some CDK tests to zoneless (#29103)
decision: Review the complete7-file67-hunk CDK test-only commit, including the two new zone specs. All190 original static it occurrences pair bijectively and three zone-specific cases preserve their operations in the new files. After finite render-mark/provider normalization,185 callbacks preserve their other operations. Five remaining case changes are reviewed individually: async panel-class stability observation, rendered-range flush/update ordering, two separate suite-qualified bottom-offset waits that retain their distinct10/0 expectations, and a buffer validation case strengthened from any throw to a specific error message with assignments inside the observer. Five modified non-case program skeletons match after the finite setup normalization and two independently reviewed viewport helper edits from animationFrameScheduler.flush to tick(16). A scheduler flush and elapsed virtual time are not declared native-equivalent. The owned legacy runner and its actual viewport consumer fixtures remain intact; public overlays/portals/scrolling are reachable and are not excluded as absent dependencies. Decline this private testing migration without weakening retained checks or forking CDK. Actual zoneful/zoneless, layout, focus, lifetime, packed-artifact and floor obligations remain open.

historical_source_review.decision: Review the complete7-file67-hunk CDK test-only commit, including the two new zone specs. All190 original static it occurrences pair bijectively and three zone-specific cases preserve their operations in the new files. After finite render-mark/provider normalization,185 callbacks preserve their other operations. Five remaining case changes are reviewed individually: async panel-class stability observation, rendered-range flush/update ordering, two separate suite-qualified bottom-offset waits that retain their distinct10/0 expectations, and a buffer validation case strengthened from any throw to a specific error message with assignments inside the observer. Five modified non-case program skeletons match after the finite setup normalization and two independently reviewed viewport helper edits from animationFrameScheduler.flush to tick(16). A scheduler flush and elapsed virtual time are not declared native-equivalent. The owned legacy runner and its actual viewport consumer fixtures remain intact; public overlays/portals/scrolling are reachable and are not excluded as absent dependencies. Decline this private testing migration without weakening retained checks or forking CDK. Actual zoneful/zoneless, layout, focus, lifetime, packed-artifact and floor obligations remain open.
